name: fraynix_engine
description: Send a command to the self-hosted Fraynix engine on the VPS and return its response.

name: hermes_run
description: Run a Hermes fleet skill or agent on the VPS.

name: speak
description: Turn text into speech through the self-hosted TTS service. Returns an audio URL.

name: elevenlabs_word_timestamps
description: STUB template, not verified against a live account. Word-level TTS. Unregistered until ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, ELEVENLABS_API_URL, and ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID are set. Adapt the path and body to your account. Free-first narration is VoiceStudio when VOICESTUDIO_MCP_URL is set; use its result only when it actually includes per-word times. speak does not return word times.

name: asset_library_fetch
description: STUB. Guessed HTTP template for a remote licensed-asset store. Unregistered until ASSET_LIBRARY_URL and ASSET_LIBRARY_TOKEN are set. The free path is asset_lookup, which only searches the shipped placeholder catalog.

name: realism_pass
description: STUB, optional, paid. Guessed prediction POST for a video realism model (for example a Replicate model you choose). Unregistered until REALISM_PREDICT_URL and REPLICATE_API_TOKEN are set. Not part of the free path. Do not treat a response as a finished cut until you confirm the vendor API.
